verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no training opt-out or no-training policy. Supermemory's own self-hosted mode runs a local LLM and local embeddings, and the docs say 'Your data never leaves the building.' That would keep data away from any vendor-side model training, but only for users who self-host. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that hosted-platform data is not used for training, a user-facing training opt-out control, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Local graph engine, local embeddings, local LLM. Your data never leaves the building.
Supermemory runs on your own hardware.
